creative_direction.name: Frosted Glass Dawn Veil
creative_direction.brief: 晨雾后的磨砂玻璃幕墙：整面 frosted 亚克力板自墙垂落并铺成连续同料地面，背光在板后晕出一团冷白晨光，织出细密霜纹；商品立于霜地偏左，接触阴影陷进磨砂颗粒。右半幅霜面保持安静，承载一根 Arial Narrow 竖排文字柱：品牌字居柱顶，题名以窄柱三行内大字排印如蚀刻签条，一条霜蓝细线横于柱底如冰裂刻度。垂直方向与瓶肩重叠、水平方向宽距分离；磨砂的漫射哑光与星瓶折面高光互为虚实。参考 R2 的手写签条式排印节奏与 R3 的雾面渐变负空间。
creative_direction.material: frosted acrylic sheet wall sweeping into continuous frosted ground with backlight glow
creative_direction.lighting: soft high-key dawn backlight diffused through frosted sheet, gentle frontal fill, no hard shadows

background.prompt: Frosted acrylic sheet in pale ice grey hanging as a wall and sweeping into a continuous matching frosted ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame, one soft cool white backlight glow blooming behind upper centre, fine frost grain, soft high-key diffuse dawn illumination, no objects

spec.lighting: soft high-key dawn backlight diffused through frosted sheet, gentle frontal fill, no hard shadows
